key_findings: **Structural variation surfaced**: receiver instance sizes vary in the 0x019D..0x01A1 cluster. AchievementTitle (template 0x019D) and AchievementId (0x019E) are 8B (vtable + 1 field). AchievementAchievedCount (0x019F) is 16B (vtable + 3 fields, ctor takes 3 args) - the only known multi-field receiver in this Achievement cluster, suggesting it carries achievement_id + count + threshold or similar tuple. VehicleGrade (0x01A1) is 5B (vtable + 1 byte) - the only known byte-sized payload in the cluster.

**Apply pattern uniform**: VehicleGrade's apply method matches the template structurally: `__RTDynamicCast(ActorBase->MyPlayer)` followed by an event firer (FUN_006F8350 for `_onGetGoobbue`). Same shape as AchievementTitleReceiver::apply (BCS-Y-0037) which fires `_onReceiveAchievementTitle`. Consistent with the client-architecture 'The C++/Lua bridge dispatch chain is a single 6-layer pipeline' single-layer dispatch convention for Pattern A receivers.

**Heap-allocation factories exist for the cluster**: ctor xref scan surfaced FUN_007627A0 (factory for AchievementIdReceiver, parallel to BCS-Y-1023 SendLogReceiver_HeapFactory_FUN_00762460) and FUN_0076CDD0 (factory for VehicleGradeReceiver). Not cataloged earlier scope - could be a follow-up tier if heap-allocation paths matter for any future analysis.
**No new opcode bindings, no matrix changes**: 0x019E/019F/01A1 remain pcap-unobserved (per finding), so no pcap-opcode-coverage-matrix row updates needed.
